topic: CI/CD, Performance, Security, and Production Readiness
learningObjectives: Explain the basic stages of a CI/CD pipeline.
Identify performance and security improvements for production applications.
Evaluate application readiness using production-focused checks.

activities.title: CI/CD Pipeline
activities.instruction: Arrange the stages of a typical CI/CD pipeline.

content.concept: A CI/CD pipeline can automatically validate changes, run tests, build application artifacts, and deploy approved changes to an environment.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Performance Selector
activities.instruction: Choose the optimization that best addresses the issue.

content.concept: Performance work should target the actual bottleneck. Common areas include frontend assets, rendering, network requests, database queries, caching, and backend processing.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

choices: A page loads a very large image that is displayed as a small thumbnail → optimize and appropriately size the image
A page loads slowly because of an expensive database query → increase the image dimensions
config.answer: A page loads a very large image that is displayed as a small thumbnail → optimize and appropriately size the image

activities.title: Security Checkpoint
activities.instruction: Explore security controls that address common application risks.

content.concept: Production applications should validate input, protect authentication, secure secrets, enforce authorization, use secure transport, and protect APIs and stored data against common attacks.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

descriptions: Checks incoming data against expected formats and constraints.
Verifies the identity of a user or service.
Determines whether an authenticated identity is allowed to perform an action.
Keeps API keys, passwords, and other sensitive configuration outside source code.
Encrypts data transmitted between clients and servers.
Limits excessive requests to reduce abuse and protect application resources.

activities.title: Production Readiness Builder
activities.instruction: Build a checklist for evaluating whether an application is ready for production.

content.concept: Production readiness combines functional testing, security, performance, monitoring, reliable configuration, backups where applicable, deployment checks, and documentation.
